method: One early baseline process and one process per experiment in Node24.22.1 and Bun1.4.2. 2048 rows, five warm-up batches, nine measured batches, four compilation-plus-scan repetitions per batch. Same data in every variant. Not process-paired; not used for final acceptance or a performance guarantee.

variants.candidate: DataView word skip; rejected for severe Bun regression. Source reconstructed from the applied patch and the saved byte-based source. Original build hashes were not captured.
variants.byte: Rejected: immediate-hit and overlapping-prefix controls slowed in the exploratory run.
variants.typed: Rejected: no reliable cross-runtime win; several Bun controls slowed.
variants.indexof: Rejected: repeated native candidate jumps slowed the adversarial repeated-prefix workload.
variants.initial: One initial native prefix skip plus length rejection. Same production source as the final paired trial; these unpaired timings are only retained development evidence.
